verdict.rationale: The only non-interactive channel in evidence is EFILE: certified tax-preparation software run by an enrolled electronic filer can transmit returns system-to-system to the CRA, which allows some programmatic filing. That channel requires third-party certified software and filer enrollment. Account management and transmission history still need an interactive sign-in with EFILE number and password, and the rest of the services (business registration, payments, document submission) are web-portal flows. Missing for 10: a publicly documented API or CLI for headless use, CI-friendly authentication (tokens or service accounts), automation beyond certified-software return transmission, and independent hands-on corroboration.
